sources.name: STORE&GO D5.9 Final report on evaluation of technologies and processes (DVGW-EBI/KIT, v2.0, 2020)
Schlautmann et al., Chem. Ing. Tech. 93 (2021) 568 (same data)
Electrochaea P2G-BioCat final report, ForskEL 2014-1-12164 (capital cross-check)

H2 per t CH4.source: D5.9 Table 4-1 p.35 (measured, Falkenhagen: 708 kW H2 -> 549 kW SNG, HHV) and Table 5-2 p.68 (5 MW design: 6450 kW H2)

CO2 per t CH4.source: D5.9 Table 5-2 p.68: 460 m3(STP)/h CO2 per 5 MW SNG (design); Audi Werlte 2.8 t/t as support

purchased energy GJ per t.source: D5.9 Table 5-2 / p.70: methanation electricity 0.29 kWh/m3 SNG (25 kW/MW) = 1.46 GJe/t, primary at 0.38; CO2 supply and grid injection outside the boundary

installed capital per annual t.source: D5.9 p.63, Table 1-2 p.7, Table 5-1 p.67: optimised Falkenhagen design 720 / ~475 / 360 EUR/kW SNG at 5 / 10 / 50 MW (EUR2017, 1.1297 USD/EUR); methanation unit only; tolerance AACE class 4

measured methanation electricity at demo.basis: D5.9 Table 4-2 p.39: 0.8 kWh/m3 SNG at Falkenhagen (0.58 MW), /0.38; Solothurn 1.0 kWh/m3 -> 13.2

BioCat 50 MWe methanation capital USD/(t.basis: BioCat final report Fig. 1.8 p.24: 63.54 MDKK

hand-built model capital USD/(t/y).basis: configs/ch4_ours.json (Goetz 2016, 175 EUR/kW); below the -30 % band of this holdout

pass_rule.rule: pass = all four targets within tolerance; partial = three within and none beyond twice the tolerance; fail otherwise. Capital target = log-log interpolation of scale_curve at the build's capacity (evaluate_builds.py).
